title: hungersteal
description: Allows players to lose hunger on death and gain hunger on each kill.
body: Hungersteal is a lifesteal lookalike plugin but instead of hearts it hunger. As minecraft doesnt allow more then 10 hunger bars. When having 10 hunger bars you will not lose any making you immortal until your armor breaks. When under 3 hearts your sprint is cooked, You can craft bread and revive beacon.
